title: What Is Xiaohongshu (Red Note) & How to Use It for Marketing

facts.fact: The page states that Xiaohongshu (RedNote) has over 300 million users.
facts.quote: With over 300 million users and a growing presence outside China, including a surge in U.S. users due to potential TikTok bans

facts.fact: The page states that Xiaohongshu was originally launched in 2013 as a travel and shopping guide.
facts.quote: Originally launched in 2013 as a travel and shopping guide, Xiaohongshu has evolved into a full-fledged social media and e-commerce platform.

facts.fact: The page states that Xiaohongshu was founded in 2013 by Miranda Qu and Charlwin Mao.
facts.quote: Xiaohongshu, founded by Miranda Qu and Charlwin Mao in 2013, has attracted major investors such as Alibaba, Tencent, and Sequoia China

facts.fact: The page reports that Xiaohongshu achieved a net profit of US$500 million on revenues of US$3.7 billion in 2023.
facts.quote: the platform achieved a net profit of US$500 million on revenues of US$3.7 billion in 2023

facts.fact: According to the page, influencers on Xiaohongshu are required to register paid promotional links with brands to differentiate paid ads from organic testimonials.
facts.quote: Influencers are required to differentiate paid advertisements from organic testimonials by registering paid promotional links with brands.

facts.fact: OOm states it has won over 30 marketing awards for client results.
facts.quote: OOm has won over 30+ marketing awards for the results we have delivered to clients over the years

facts.fact: OOm states it is a Google Premier Partner, a status the page says is reserved for the top 3% of agency partners in Singapore.
facts.quote: OOm is also a Google Premier Partner (reserved for the top 3% agency partners in Singapore)

facts.fact: The page says Xiaohongshu has millions of active users, particularly in China, without giving an exact count.
facts.quote: Xiaohongshu has seen explosive growth in its user base, with millions of active users, particularly in China.

facts.fact: The page says much of Xiaohongshu's user-generated content may not be fully translated, so content can mix English and Chinese.
facts.quote: some interface elements and much of the user-generated content (UGC) may not be fully translated
